inventory_scope: Sherlock paths used by, referenced by, or discovered while reconciling the canonical br_autoresearch workspace with the legacy autoresearch workspace
interpretation: A listed path is an observed storage location, not launch permission or scientific evidence.
Logical byte counts are non-additive when a parent and its children are both listed or when files are hard-linked.
Byte fields are inventory snapshots, not quota usage: release-tree totals are regular-file sums, while inaccessible protected trees are explicitly reported only as lower bounds or unknown.
The private steward tree and EP17 restricted raw tree now reside under the private br_autoresearch_data root after same-filesystem renames.
The five named duplicate sources were removed after their durable counterparts were retained; this records completed cleanup and does not authorize further deletion.
Recovery, evaluator-only, restricted, and audit material must retain their access boundaries during any later migration.
Live Brain Researcher service state under /app/jobstore/autoresearch is outside this filesystem inventory.

migration_state_definitions.canonical_in_place: Already in the selected durable location; no relocation planned.
migration_state_definitions.external_in_place: Managed external shared pool; referenced in place and not owned by this migration.
migration_state_definitions.relocated_source_absent: A named source path is absent after its same-filesystem rename to the recorded durable destination.
migration_state_definitions.duplicate_removed: A named duplicate source is absent after authorized cleanup while its recorded durable counterpart remains present.
migration_state_definitions.absent_planned_target: The destination is intentionally absent at the observation time.
migration_state_definitions.protected_hold: Retain exactly in place until a separate access-aware decision is approved.
migration_state_definitions.transient_retained: Scratch/runtime data remain in place; no cleanup was authorized.
migration_state_definitions.duplicate_review: A possible duplicate or superseded staging copy requires separate review before any cleanup decision.
migration_state_definitions.same_allocation_alias: A legacy path and a durable path refer to the same hard-linked file allocation; removal still requires explicit review because link topology matters.
migration_state_definitions.destination_unassigned: The current location is inventoried, but no destination has been approved.

known_inconsistencies.finding: The initial catalog listed 14 releases while 28 were observed under the public shared root.
known_inconsistencies.resolution: DATA_CATALOG.md now lists all 28 releases and declares source-only totals separately from this manifest's full release-tree totals.

known_inconsistencies.finding: The OpenNeuro analyses catalog initially reported 54 dataset directories while 55 ds-prefixed directories were observed.
known_inconsistencies.resolution: DATA_CATALOG.md now reports 55 ds-prefixed dataset directories and distinguishes the two auxiliary directories.

known_inconsistencies.finding: EP16 initially called its public source read-only, but the observed release root and payload were mode 2770 and writable.
known_inconsistencies.resolution: EP16 now records integrity verification separately from its pending write seal. The underlying permission seal remains a readiness blocker; Phase 1 made no source permission change.
